name: GRUE
description: GRUE (General Reinforced-language Understanding Evaluation) is a benchmark consisting of 6 language generation tasks supervised by reward functions capturing automated measures of human preference. It is designed to evaluate reinforcement learning algorithms for aligning language models with human preferences.
reputation: An early and influential but relatively niche benchmark for RL-based language alignment, cited mainly in work on reward modeling and preference optimization.
notes: First leaderboard-style evaluation of RL algorithms for NLP tasks; supervised by reward functions rather than target strings.
